SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) s, MAX(calendar_date) e, MIN(fiscal_week) w1, MAX(fiscal_week) w2, COUNT(*) n, (SELECT fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar r WHERE r.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND r.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) fl
FROM dim_date d WHERE fiscal_period=4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH nl AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS bd, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
), a AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(v) fact_net FROM nl n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.bd WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2
), b AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(a.fiscal_year,b.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(a.store_id,b.store_id) store_id, a.fact_net, b.rpt_net, ROUND(a.fact_net-b.rpt_net,2) diff
FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.fiscal_year=b.fiscal_year AND a.store_id=b.store_id
WHERE a.fact_net IS NULL OR b.rpt_net IS NULL OR abs(a.fact_net-b.rpt_net)>0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, st.store_name, st.open_date, st.close_date, d.fiscal_week,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date) days_with_sales, SUM(f.net_amount) net,
        COUNT(*) n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id*1000+f.line_no) n_distinct_lines
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=s.store_id AND st.is_current
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17
 GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT store_id, store_name, open_date, close_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net END) ty, SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net END) ly,
  ROUND(100*(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net END)/SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net END)-1),1) g,
  MIN(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN days_with_sales END) mind_ty, MIN(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN days_with_sales END) mind_ly,
  SUM(n_lines-n_distinct_lines) dup_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year||fiscal_week) wk_cnt
FROM x GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY g

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, s.store_id IN (127,105,109,119) AS lowgroup,
       COUNT(*) lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),0) net,
       MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) min_load, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) max_load, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(f.etl_loaded_at AS DATE)) load_days,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id),2) atv,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 12 AND 19
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'sales' k, d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id*1000+line_no) d_rl, SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), SUM(CASE WHEN refund_net<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2
